posts.caption: You don’t need another noisy app—just one that respects your salah and your privacy. posts.caption:
Honest question: how many “Islamic” apps are quietly phoning home?

EasySalah is built different—logic stays on-device, no backend, no login wall. You get merged fard + nafl rows, next-prayer countdown, Qibla with declination correction, Zakat (simple + detailed + nisab check + motivation), Wealth Tracker with hawl countdowns, full Hijri calendar with important dates, widgets on Home + Lock Screen, and 7 languages.

If you’ve been meaning to tighten your salah routine, this is the kind of tool you install and *keep*.

posts.caption: Between work, family, and notifications, salah can feel like one more thing to track. EasySalah helps you stay ahead: location-based times with method + madhab options, gentle banners at prohibited prayer windows, Islamic calendar with curated dates and optional reminders, tasbih with history, and Home + Lock Screen widgets so glances count—even when life is loud. No accounts, no ads—just a companion that stays on your phone. If you’ve been putting off a better routine, start with the app that doesn’t ask for your email.
